about_the_game:
"Cat Girl Survivor: Bullet Action" is a shooting action game that combines the simple gameplay of a vampire-like survival game with diverse characters, equipment items, skills, and play modes. Choose your own character, acquire various equipment and skills, and save the cat girl world threatened by demons!

Key Features

A Colorful Skills and Casting System

To effectively take down demons, make use of a variety of skills and the unique casting skill system exclusive to "Cat Girl Survivor: Bullet Action." The casting skill has a critical weakness: you can’t move while charging its power. However, it delivers wide-ranging and powerful damage to enemies as a reward. Strategically combine casting skills with regular skills to efficiently defeat demons!

level up your skills to Legendary status to enjoy colorful and cool strikes.

Diverse Characters

In addition to the default character, there are unique characters with different skills and abilities. Pick a character that suits your playstyle and charms you—whether it’s Akane, Shiro, Koro, or others—and dive into the game!

Variety of Gameplay Modes

"Cat Girl Survivor: Bullet Action" offers more than just a story mode. Enjoy diverse play modes like ‘Adventure Mode’ and ‘Infinite Dungeon.’ Experience the primal thrill of infinite dungeons from classic vampire-like games and the fresh fun of a roguelike system in ‘Adventure Mode’ for a rich and varied gameplay experience.
